title: derris rufescens
intro: Derris rufescens, commonly known as the Kanthari or Snake Grass, is a plant species in the family Leguminosae. It is native to India and Southeast Asia and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Derris rufescens include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
